spec.title: JBMC's stubs on no path are no gaps: examples 071 and 013 under strict, and the conformance corpus under JBMC and auto
spec.description: Item 3 of llm-dlc/loops/engine-priorities.md's Progress (Phase 5). Job 20261106-203501 found 071's first two property proofs still no verdict under strict: the models of Enum.<init>, List.of and List.copyOf are used, but JBMC's gap preflight (lib/src/jbmc_gaps.rs) walks JBMC's call graph, which takes every branch, and reaches the stubs Collection.isEmpty and Collection.toArray in the model's ImmutableCollections.listCopy, which calls them only for a collection other than the immutable lists List.of makes, and no path gives it one (Decision's record constructor copies List.of's list). Now, when the call graph reaches a stub, the preflight also runs JBMC's symbolic execution of the proof (jbmc --program-only with the proof's unwind, unwinding assertions and options, over every input, solving nothing), reads which functions its formula's steps come from by the goto listing's location numbers (each checked against the listing's comment for it), and a stub none of them comes from is no gap; a run that fails, does not finish within the preflight's minute or does not match leaves the call graph's gaps. Checked inline: unit tests, including a real JBMC 6.11.0 run on tests/fixtures/jbmc-paths/P.java (List.copyOf over List.of's list: the two stubs reached in the call graph, not entered; over an opaque Collection: entered, a gap); the whole Rust suite passes. Steps: build; 071 under strict (expected violation, as recorded); a check that 071's obligations 1 and 2 are verified with no gap, 3 a violation, and its output names the stubs as never entered; 013 under strict (expected violation) with no JBMC gap left; the conformance corpus under JBMC and auto, strict (the ignored test), which must raise no disagreement with the JVM now that fewer stubs are gaps.
spec.expected: 071 and 013 give their recorded verdicts (violation) under strict; 071's obligations 1 and 2 verified with no gap and 3 a violation; 071's and 013's outputs name Collection.isEmpty and toArray as never entered and list no jbmc gap; the conformance test passes under JBMC and auto
